summary: Mark dependent-resource fetch failures as sync failures, and key the local SQLite store by credential so ad accounts stay isolated.
reason: Two P1 review findings. (1) In the dependent fetch loop, a transport, timeout, or non-access HTTP error set outcome.reason but never rep.failure, so the aggregator reported a successful sync over an incomplete mirror; this was observed live when a 404 dependent still produced success:9 errored:0. (2) defaultDBPath returned one account-agnostic data.db, but every OpenAI Ads API key is scoped to exactly one ad account, so switching keys mixed campaigns, ads, and snapshot history across accounts.
validated_outcome: A/B test with a forced-404 dependent: with the fix sync reports success:2 errored:1; with it reverted the same run reports success:3 errored:0. doctor shows distinct db_path values for distinct credentials and falls back to data.db when unset.
upstream_issue: Both are generator-template issues, not specific to this API; filed for Printing Press retro.
